title: Value Cards: An Educational Toolkit for Teaching Social Impacts of Machine Learning through Deliberation
reasoning: The paper presents and evaluates the 'Value Cards' toolkit, which is specifically designed to teach computer science students about the ethics and social impacts of machine learning (FATE: Fairness, Accountability, Transparency, and Ethics). The core of the research involves evaluating how well this toolkit helps students deliberate on and negotiate moral and social values in algorithmic decision-making.
